title: coleus robustus
intro: Coleus robustus, commonly known as Coleus aromaticus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae, native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its aromatic leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for their medicinal properties. The health benefits of Coleus robustus include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antibacterial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving nausea, digestive issues, and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Coleus robustus include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
